adminannounce-server-hint: Without the server right the text is cleaned of markup and cut to 500 characters.
adminwho-no-admins-hint: Adminhelps are also sent through TGS to services like IRC and Discord. If no admins are available in game, sending an adminhelp might still be noticed and responded to.
antag-abductor-desc-1: Abductors are technologically advanced alien society set on cataloging all species in the system. Unfortunately for their subjects their methods are quite invasive.
antag-abductor-desc-2: You and a partner will become the abductor scientist and agent duo. As an agent, abduct unassuming victims and bring them back to your UFO. As a scientist, scout out victims for your agent, keep them safe, and operate on whoever they bring back.
antag-blob-desc-1: The blob infests the station and destroys everything in its path, including hull, fixtures, and creatures. Spread your mass, collect resources, and consume the entire station. Make sure to prepare your defenses, because the crew will be alerted to your presence!
antag-blobinfection-desc-1: At any point in the middle of the shift, be strucken with an infection that will turn you into the terrifying blob.
antag-blobinfection-desc-2: The blob infests the station and destroys everything in its path, including hull, fixtures, and creatures. Spread your mass, collect resources, and consume the entire station. Make sure to prepare your defenses, because the crew will be alerted to your presence!
antag-bloodbrother-desc-1: Team up with other crew members as blood brothers to combine the strengths of your departments, break each other out of prison, and overwhelm the station.
antag-bloodworm-desc-1: Become a giant, parasitic blood worm. Start as a hatchling in a host, consume blood and conquer the entire station alongside your siblings!
antag-bloodworminfestation-desc-1: Become a giant, parasitic blood worm. Start as a hatchling, take hosts, consume blood and conquer the entire station alongside your siblings!
antag-changeling-desc-1: A highly intelligent alien predator that is capable of altering their shape to flawlessly resemble a human.
antag-changeling-desc-2: Transform yourself or others into different identities, and buy from an arsenal of biological weaponry with the DNA you collect.
antag-changelingmidround-desc-1: A midround changeling does not receive a crew identity, instead arriving from space. This will be more difficult than being a round-start changeling!
antag-changelingmidround-desc-2: Transform yourself or others into different identities, and buy from an arsenal of biological weaponry with the DNA you collect.
antag-clownoperative-desc-1: Honk! You have been chosen, for better or worse to join the Syndicate Clown Operative strike team. Your mission, whether or not you choose to tickle it, is to honk Nanotrasen's most advanced research facility! That's right, you're going to Clown Station 13.
antag-clownoperative-desc-2: Retrieve the nuclear authentication disk, use it to activate the nuclear fission explosive, and destroy the station.
antag-clownoperativemidround-desc-1: A form of clown operative that is offered to ghosts in the middle of the shift.
antag-clownoperativemidround-desc-2: Retrieve the nuclear authentication disk, use it to activate the nuclear fission explosive, and destroy the station.
antag-cultist-desc-1: The Geometer of Blood, Nar-Sie, has sent a number of her followers to Space Station 13. As a cultist, you have an abundance of cult magics at your disposal, something for all situations. You must work with your brethren to summon an avatar of your eldritch goddess!
antag-cultist-desc-2: Armed with blood magic, convert crew members to the Blood Cult, sacrifice those who get in the way, and summon Nar-Sie.
antag-fugitive-desc-1: Wherever you come from, you're being hunted. You have 10 minutes to prepare before fugitive hunters arrive and start hunting you and your friends down!
antag-glitch-desc-1: The virtual domain is a dangerous place for bitrunners. Make it so.
antag-glitch-desc-2: You are a short-term antagonist, a glitch in the system. Use martial arts and lethal weaponry to terminate organics.
antag-headrevolutionary-desc-2: Armed with a flash, convert as many people to the revolution as you can. Kill or exile all heads of staff on the station.
antag-heretic-desc-1: Forgotten, devoured, gutted. Humanity has forgotten the eldritch forces of decay, but the mansus veil has weakened. We will make them taste fear again...
antag-heretic-desc-2: Find hidden influences and sacrifice crew members to gain magical powers and ascend as one of several paths.
antag-loneoperative-desc-1: A solo nuclear operative that has a higher chance of spawning the longer the nuclear authentication disk stays in one place.
antag-loneoperative-desc-2: Retrieve the nuclear authentication disk, use it to activate the nuclear fission explosive, and destroy the station.
antag-malfai-desc-1: With a law zero to complete your objectives at all costs, combine your omnipotence and malfunction modules to wreak havoc across the station. Go delta to destroy the station and all those who opposed you.
antag-malfaimidround-desc-1: A form of malfunctioning AI that is given to existing AIs in the middle of the shift.
antag-malfaimidround-desc-2: With a law zero to complete your objectives at all costs, combine your omnipotence and malfunction modules to wreak havoc across the station. Go delta to destroy the station and all those who opposed you.
antag-nightmare-desc-1: Use your light eater to break sources of light to survive and thrive. Jaunt through the darkness and seek your prey with night vision.
antag-obsessed-desc-1: You're obsessed with someone! Your obsession may begin to notice their personal items are stolen and their coworkers have gone missing, but will they realize they are your next victim in time?
antag-operative-desc-1: Congratulations, agent. You have been chosen to join the Syndicate Nuclear Operative strike team. Your mission, whether or not you choose to accept it, is to destroy Nanotrasen's most advanced research facility! That's right, you're going to Space Station 13.
antag-operative-desc-2: Retrieve the nuclear authentication disk, use it to activate the nuclear fission explosive, and destroy the station.
antag-operativemidround-desc-1: A form of nuclear operative that is offered to ghosts in the middle of the shift.
antag-operativemidround-desc-2: Retrieve the nuclear authentication disk, use it to activate the nuclear fission explosive, and destroy the station.
antag-paradoxclone-desc-1: A freak time-space anomaly has teleported you into another reality! Now you have to find your counterpart and kill and replace them.
antag-provocateur-desc-1: A form of head revolutionary that can activate when joining an ongoing shift.
antag-provocateur-desc-2: Armed with a flash, convert as many people to the revolution as you can. Kill or exile all heads of staff on the station.
antag-revenant-desc-1: Become the mysterious revenant. Break windows, overload lights, and eat the crew's life force, all while talking to your old community of disgruntled ghosts.
antag-sentiencepotionspawn-desc-1: Either by cosmic happenstance, or due to crew's shenanigans, you have been given sentience!
antag-sentiencepotionspawn-desc-2: This is a blanket preference. The more benign ones include random human level intelligence events, the cargorilla, and creatures uplifted via sentience potions. The less friendly ones include the regal rat, and the boosted mining elite mobs.
antag-spacedragon-desc-1: Become a ferocious space dragon. Breathe fire, summon an army of space carps, crush walls, and terrorize the station.
antag-spaceninja-desc-1: The Spider Clan practice a sort of augmentation of human flesh in order to achieve a more perfect state of being and follow Postmodern Space Bushido.
antag-spaceninja-desc-2: Become a conniving space ninja, equipped with a katana, gloves to hack into airlocks and APCs, a suit to make you go near-invisible, as well as a variety of abilities in your kit. Hack into arrest consoles to mark everyone as arrest, and even hack into communication consoles to summon more threats to cause chaos on the station!
antag-spy-desc-1: Your mission, should you choose to accept it: Infiltrate Space Station 13. Disguise yourself as a member of their crew and steal vital equipment. Should you be caught or killed, your employer will disavow any knowledge of your actions. Good luck agent.
antag-spy-desc-2: Complete Spy Bounties to earn rewards from your employer. Use these rewards to sow chaos and mischief!
antag-stowawaychangeling-desc-1: A Changeling that found its way onto the shuttle unbeknownst to the crewmembers on board.
antag-stowawaychangeling-desc-2: Transform yourself or others into different identities, and buy from an arsenal of biological weaponry with the DNA you collect.
antag-syndicateinfiltrator-desc-1: A form of traitor that can activate when joining an ongoing shift.
antag-syndicateinfiltrator-desc-2: Start with an uplink to purchase your gear and take on your sinister objectives. Ascend through the ranks and become an infamous legend.
antag-syndicatesleeperagent-desc-1: A form of traitor that can activate at any point in the middle of the shift.
antag-syndicatesleeperagent-desc-2: Start with an uplink to purchase your gear and take on your sinister objectives. Ascend through the ranks and become an infamous legend.
antag-traitor-desc-1: An unpaid debt. A score to be settled. Maybe you were just in the wrong place at the wrong time. Whatever the reasons, you were selected to infiltrate Space Station 13.
antag-traitor-desc-2: Start with an uplink to purchase your gear and take on your sinister objectives. Ascend through the ranks and become an infamous legend.
antag-voidwalker-desc-1: Move through space and pull people into the void. Declare solars an independent nation.
antag-wizard-desc-1: "GREETINGS. WE'RE THE WIZARDS OF THE WIZARD'S FEDERATION."
antag-wizard-desc-2: Choose between a variety of powerful spells in order to cause chaos among Space Station 13.
antag-wizardmidround-desc-1: A form of wizard that is offered to ghosts in the middle of the shift.
antag-wizardmidround-desc-2: Choose between a variety of powerful spells in order to cause chaos among Space Station 13.
antag-xenomorph-desc-1: Become the extraterrestrial xenomorph. Start as a larva, and progress your way up the caste, including even the Queen!
banpanel-hint-banned: Red: already banned from this role.
banpanel-hint-mirror-edit: When ticked, edits here will also affect bans created with matching ckey, IP, CID and time. Use this to edit all role bans which were made at the same time.
banpanel-label-last-connection: Use IP and CID from last connection
banpanel-notice-admins: This ban applies to admins too.
banpanel-notice-server: Server ban: the player is cut off from the whole game.
banpanel-tooltip-last-connection: Takes the IP and CID of the key from the database when the ban is created.
banpanel-warning-no-duration: Enter a duration or tick Permanent.
cinematic-entry-cult_arm-desc: The blood cult summoned Nar'Sie and most of the station was harvested or converted.
cinematic-entry-cult_fail-desc: The cult summoned Nar'Sie, but someone destroyed her.
cinematic-entry-malf-desc: A malfunctioning AI activated the doomsday device and wiped the station.
cinematic-entry-nuke-desc: The base nuclear intro without a specific ending. Mostly useful for tests.
cinematic-entry-nuke_clown-desc: The clown operative bomb was activated and clowned the station.
cinematic-entry-nuke_cult-desc: Central Command deployed a nuclear package to stop a summoned Nar'Sie.
cinematic-entry-nuke_fake-desc: The bomb winds up with a bike horn but does not explode.
cinematic-entry-nuke_far_explosion-desc: A global explosion sound without an intro. The bomb missed the station by a whole z-level.
cinematic-entry-nuke_mutual_destruction-: The nuclear operatives failed to leave on their shuttle before the bomb went off on the station.
cinematic-entry-nuke_no_core-desc: The bomb winds up, but there was no nuclear core inside.
cinematic-entry-nuke_ops_miss-desc: The Syndicate nuclear bomb detonated, but just missed the station.
cinematic-entry-nuke_ops_victory-desc: The Syndicate nuclear bomb detonated and destroyed the station.
cinematic-entry-nuke_self_destruct-desc: The self destruct or another station-destroying threat wiped out the station.
cinematic-entry-nuke_self_destruct_miss-: The self destruct was activated, yet the station somehow survived.
cinematic-lock: Lock viewer controls while it plays
cinematic-mode-admins-hint: Every admin who is currently online.
cinematic-mode-all-hint: Plays globally for every player, pauses OOC like a round-end cinematic.
cinematic-mode-living-hint: Every player who is currently controlling a living mob.
cinematic-mode-observers-hint: Every player who is currently a ghost.
cinematic-mode-players-hint: Only the players ticked in the list below.
cinematic-mode-self-hint: Plays only for your current body, good for a preview.
cinematic-selected-none: Pick a cinematic from the list
design-bluespace_pod-name: Express Supply Drop Pod Upgrade Disk
design-board_mechapower-name: Mech Bay Power Control Console Board
design-unique_modkit_offensive_turf_aoe-: Kinetic Accelerator Offensive Mining Explosion Mod
escape-menu-quit-prompt: Are you sure you wish to quit?
escape-menu-resource-changelog-tooltip: See all changes to the server
escape-menu-resource-github-tooltip: Open the repository for the game
escape-menu-resource-wiki-tooltip: See the wiki for the game
escape-menu-ticket-notification: An admin is trying to talk to you!
ipintel-error-disabled: IPIntel is not enabled, the record cannot be refreshed
ipintel-error-no-address: Could not find an IP address for this ckey
ipintel-error-query-failed: The query failed, the old record was removed
ipintel-error-rate-limited: The request limit is reached, try again later
ipintel-problem-base: No query host in the config
ipintel-problem-email: No valid contact email in the config
job-ai-desc: Assist the crew, follow your laws, coordinate your cyborgs.
job-assistant-desc: Get your space legs, assist people, ask the HoP to give you a job.
job-atmospheric_technician-desc: Ensure the air is breathable on the station, fill oxygen tanks, fight fires, purify the air.
job-bartender-desc: Serve booze, mix drinks, keep the crew drunk.
job-big_brother-desc: Assist the crew, open airlocks, follow your lawset, and coordinate your cyborgs.
job-bitrunner-desc: Surf the virtual domain for gear and loot, decrypt your rewards on station.
job-botanist-desc: Grow plants for the cook, for medicine, and for recreation.
job-bridge_assistant-desc: Watch over the Bridge, command its consoles, and spend your days brewing coffee for higher-ups.
job-captain-desc: Be responsible for the station, manage your Heads of Staff, keep the crew alive, be prepared to do anything and everything or die horribly trying.
job-cargo_gorilla-desc: Assist the supply department by moving freight and disposing of unwanted fruits.
job-cargo_technician-desc: Distribute supplies to the departments that ordered them, collect empty crates, load and unload the supply shuttle, ship bounty cubes.
job-chaplain-desc: Hold services and funerals, cremate people, preach your religion, protect the crew against cults.
job-chemist-desc: Supply the doctors with chemicals, make medicine, cook up sketchy substances in the comfort of a fully reinforced room.
job-chief_engineer-desc: Coordinate engineering, ensure equipment doesn't get stolen, make sure the Supermatter doesn't blow up, maintain telecommunications.
job-chief_medical_officer-desc: Coordinate doctors and other medbay employees, ensure they know how to save lives, check for injuries on the crew monitor.
job-clown-desc: Entertain the crew, make bad jokes, go on a holy quest to find bananium, HONK!
job-cook-desc: Serve food, cook meat, keep the crew fed.
job-coroner-desc: Perform autopsies whenever needed, update medical records accordingly, apply formaldehyde.
job-curator-desc: Read and write books and hand them to people, stock bookshelves, report on station news.
job-cyborg-desc: Assist the crew, follow your laws, obey your AI.
job-detective-desc: Investigate crimes, gather evidence, perform interrogations, look badass, smoke cigarettes.
job-geneticist-desc: Alter genomes, turn monkeys into humans (and vice-versa), and make DNA backups.
job-head_of_personnel-desc: Alter access on ID cards, manage the service department, protect Ian, run the station when the Captain dies.
job-head_of_security-desc: Coordinate security personnel, ensure they are not corrupt, make sure every department is protected.
job-janitor-desc: Clean up trash and blood, replace broken lights, slip people over.
job-lawyer-desc: Advocate for prisoners, create law-binding contracts, ensure Security is following protocol and Space Law.
job-medical_doctor-desc: Save lives, run around the station looking for victims, scan everyone in sight.
job-paramedic-desc: Run around the station looking for patients, respond to emergencies, give patients a roller bed ride to medbay.
job-psychologist-desc: Advocate sanity, self-esteem, and teamwork in a station staffed with headcases.
job-pun_pun-desc: Assist the service department by serving drinks and food and entertaining the crew.
job-quartermaster-desc: Coordinate cargo technicians and shaft miners, assist with economical purchasing.
job-research_director-desc: Supervise research efforts, ensure Robotics is in working order, make sure the AI and its Cyborgs aren't rogue, replace them if they are.
job-roboticist-desc: Build and repair the AI and cyborgs, create mechs.
job-scientist-desc: Do experiments, perform research, feed the slimes, make bombs.
job-security_officer-desc: Protect company assets, follow the Standard Operating Procedure, eat donuts.
job-shaft_miner-desc: Travel to strange lands, mine ores, meet strange creatures, kill them for their gold.
job-station_engineer-desc: Start the Supermatter, wire the solars, repair station hull and wiring damage.
job-veteran_security_advisor-desc: Advise HoS, and Captain on matters of Security. Train green Officers. Lay back in your wheelchair and say "I told you" to the HoS when all of the station collapses.
job-warden-desc: Watch over the Brig and Prison Wing, release prisoners when their time is up, issue equipment to security, be a security officer when they all eventually die.
jobselection-prioritized: The HoP wants more people in this job!
jobselection-random-tooltip: Roll target random job. You can re-roll or cancel your random job if you don't like it.
jobselection-round-duration: It is currently { $time } into the shift.
lathe-mineral-hold: Mineral access is on hold, please contact the quartermaster.
lathe-silo-no-match: No logs seem to match your request.
lathe-silo-search: Search for names, locations and resources...
loadout-clear-all-tooltip: Clears ALL selected items from all categories.
loadout-error-category: Erroneous category detected! This is a bug, please report it.
permissions-flags-temporary: This affects only this admin and only the current round.
permissions-house-unused-line: Rank { $rank } is not held by any admin
permissions-legacy-only: Database rank loading is disabled, only temporary changes can be made.
permissions-permanent-hint: Permanent changes are saved to the database for future rounds, temporary ones affect only the current round
personality-aloof-desc: Why is everyone so touchy? I'd rather be left alone.
personality-aloof-neg: Dislikes being grabbed, touched, or hugged
personality-analytical-desc: When it comes to making decisions, I tend to be more impersonal.
personality-analytical-neut: Prefers working in systemic environments like engineering, research, or medical
personality-animal_averse-desc: We can barely survive on this station, and you want to keep a pet?
personality-animal_friend-desc: I love animals! They'll never leave my side.
personality-animal_friend-neg: Seeing a pet's death affects your mood more
personality-apathetic-desc: I don't care about much. Not the good, nor the bad, and certainly not the ugly.
personality-ascetic-desc: I don't care much for luxurious foods - It's all fuel for the body.
personality-ascetic-neg: Enjoyment from eating liked food is limited
personality-ascetic-pos: Sorrow from eating disliked food is reduced
personality-athletic-desc: Can't just sit around all day! Have to keep moving.
personality-bibulous-desc: I'll always go for another round of drinks!
personality-bibulous-pos: Fulfillment from drinking lasts longer, even after you are no longer drunk
personality-brave-desc: It'll take a lot more than a little blood to scare me.
personality-brave-pos: Accumulate fear slower, and moodlets related to fear are weaker
personality-brooding-desc: Everything gets to me and I can't help but think about it.
personality-callous-desc: I don't care much about what happens to other people.
personality-compassionate-desc: I like giving a hand to those in need.
personality-compassionate-neg: Seeing death affects your mood more
personality-cowardly-desc: Everything is a danger around here! Even the air!
personality-cowardly-neg: Accumulate fear faster, and moodlets related to fear are stronger
personality-creative-desc: I like expressing myself, especially in a chaotic place like this.
personality-creative-pos: Likes making and seeing art or playing music
personality-diligent-desc: Things need to get done around here!
personality-diligent-neg: Unhappy when slacking off in the bar or recreation areas
personality-disillusioned-desc: Nanotrasen isn't what it used to be. This isn't what I signed up for.
personality-empathetic-desc: Other people's feelings are important to me.
personality-erudite-desc: Knowledge is power. Especially this deep in space.
personality-extroverted-desc: I prefer to be surrounded by people, having a drink at the Bar.
personality-gambler-desc: Throwing the dice is always worth it!
personality-gambler-pos: Likes gambling and card games, and content with losing when gambling
personality-gourmand-neg: Sadness from eating food you dislike is increased, and mediocre food is less enjoyable
personality-gourmand-pos: Enjoyment from eating liked food is strengthened
personality-hopeful-desc: I believe things will always get better.
personality-impulsive-desc: I'm better making stuff up as I go along.
personality-impulsive-neut: Prefers working in social environments like cargo, command, security, or service
personality-industrious-desc: Everyone needs to be working - otherwise we're all wasting our time.
personality-introverted-desc: I prefer to be alone, reading or painting in the library.
personality-invalid-tooltip: You cannot select this personality with { $name }.
personality-lazy-desc: I don't really feel like working today.
personality-lazy-pos: Happy in the bar or recreation areas
personality-loyal-desc: I believe in the station and in Central Command, till the very end!
personality-maximum-tooltip: You are at the maximum number of personalities.
personality-misanthropic-desc: We should have never entered the stars.
personality-paranoid-desc: Everyone and everything is out to get me! This place is a deathtrap!
personality-paranoid-neg: Stressed when with one other person, or in large groups
personality-paranoid-pos: Likes being alone or in moderately-sized groups
personality-pessimistic-desc: I believe our best days are behind us.
personality-resilient-desc: It's whatever. I can take it!
personality-sensitive-desc: I am easily influenced by the world around me.
personality-snobbish-desc: I expect only the best out of this station - anything less is unacceptable!
personality-spiritual-desc: I believe in a higher power.
personality-spiritual-pos: Likes the Chapel and the Chaplain, and has special prayers
personality-uneducated-desc: I don't care much for books - I already know everything I need to know.
personality-unimaginative-desc: I'm not good at thinking outside the box. The box is there for a reason.
personality-unimaginative-neg: Ignores art or music and dislikes making new art
personality-whimsical-desc: This station is too serious sometimes, lighten up!
personality-whimsical-pos: Likes ostensibly pointless but silly things, and does not mind clownish pranks
playerpanel-not-living: This mob has no health status.
pref-admin_tgui_context_menu-desc: Open the TGUI admin menu with Ctrl+Shift+Right click on an object. Plain right click and the native menu are not affected.
pref-admin_tgui_context_menu-name: Admin context menu on Ctrl+Shift+Right click
pref-ambientocclusion-desc: Enable ambient occlusion, light shadows around characters.
pref-broadcast_login_logout-desc: When enabled, disconnecting and reconnecting will announce to deadchat.
pref-buttons_locked-desc: When enabled, action buttons will be locked in place.
pref-chat_bankcard-desc: Receive notifications for your bank account.
pref-chat_ghostears-desc: When enabled, you will be able to hear all speech as a ghost. When disabled, you will only be able to hear nearby speech.
pref-chat_ghostlaws-desc: When enabled, be notified of any new law changes as a ghost.
pref-chat_ghostpda-desc: When enabled, be notified of any PDA messages as a ghost.
pref-chat_ghostradio-desc: When enabled, be notified of any radio messages as a ghost.
pref-chat_ghostsight-desc: When enabled, see all emotes as a ghost.
pref-chat_ghostwhisper-desc: When enabled, you will be able to hear all whispers as a ghost. When disabled, you will only be able to hear nearby whispers.
pref-chat_login_logout-desc: When enabled, be notified when a player logs in or out.
pref-chat_on_ghosts-desc: Chat messages will show above ghosts when they speak.
pref-chat_on_map-desc: Chat messages will show above heads.
pref-chat_pullr-desc: Be notified when a pull request is made, closed, or merged.
pref-csl_strength-desc: The percentage of Common you can understand.
pref-darkened_flash-desc: When toggled, being flashed will show a dark screen rather than a bright one.
pref-disable_arrivalrattle-desc: When enabled, you will be notified as a ghost for new crew.
pref-disable_deathrattle-desc: When enabled, you will be notified as a ghost whenever someone dies.
pref-disable_lobby_transparency-desc: Prevent admins from making the lobby screen transparent.
pref-emissive_bloom-desc: How strong the bloom on emissive objects, such as computer screens, is. This has negligible performance impact.
pref-enable_tips-desc: Do you want to see tooltips when hovering over items?
pref-fullscreen_mode-desc: Toggles Fullscreen for the game, can also be toggled with F11.
pref-ghost_accs-desc: Determines what adjustments your ghost will have.
pref-ghost_form-desc: The appearance of your ghost. Requires BYOND membership.
pref-ghost_lighting-desc: Effects the brightness of lights for ghosts
pref-ghost_orbit-desc: The shape in which your ghost will orbit. Requires BYOND membership.
pref-ghost_others-desc: Do you want the ghosts of others to show up as their own setting, as their default sprites, or always as the default white ghost?
pref-ghost_roles-desc: If you de-select this, you will not get any ghost role pop-ups what-so-ever! Every single type of these pop-ups WILL be muted for you when you are ghosted. Very useful for those who find ghost roles or the pop-ups annoying, use at your own peril.
pref-hotkeys-desc: When enabled, will revert to the legacy hotkeys, using the input bar rather than popups.
pref-inquisitive_ghost-desc: Clicking on something as a ghost will examine it.
pref-interface_language-desc: The language of chat messages, item names and descriptions. The change applies immediately, no reconnect is needed.
pref-itemoutline_pref-desc: When enabled, hovering over items will outline them.
pref-language_skill-desc: The percentage of the language you can understand.
pref-language_speakable-desc: If unchecked, you'll only be able to understand the language, but not speak it.
pref-max_chat_length-desc: The maximum length a Runechat message will show as.
pref-member_public-desc: When enabled, a BYOND logo will be shown next to your name in OOC.
pref-min_recoil_multiplier-desc: Modifies the strength of cosmetic recoil's effect on your camera. 0 will disable cosmetic recoil entirely, though mechanical recoil will be unaffected.
pref-mod_select-desc: The key you need to use an active MODsuit module.
pref-multiz_parallax-desc: Enable multi-z parallax, for a 3D effect.
pref-multiz_performance-desc: How many Multi-Z levels are rendered before they start getting culled. Decrease this to improve performance in case of lag on multi-z maps.
pref-ooccolor-desc: The color of your OOC messages.
pref-particle_weather-desc: Enable fancy particle weather. Incompatible with AMD GPUs and will cause heavy lag on them due to a BYOND bug.
pref-persistent_scars-desc: If checked, scars will persist across rounds if you survive to the end.
pref-playtime_reward_cloak-desc: Your reward for playing 5k+ hours. Don a fancy cloak only wearable by fellow super-veterans.
pref-preferred_ai_emote_display-desc: If you are the AI, the default image displayed on all AI displays on station.
pref-preferred_ai_hologram_display-desc: The holographic form you will take when you use a holopad.
pref-preferred_map-desc: During map rotation, prefer this map be chosen. This does not affect the map vote, only random rotation when a vote is not held.
pref-prisoner_crime-desc: When a prisoner, this will be added to your records as the reason for your arrest.
pref-rds_limit-desc: Checking this box will remove limitations on hallucinations, causing them to be more frequent, intrusive, and (generally) wacky.
pref-remove_double_click-desc: When toggled, actions that require a double click will instead offer alternatives, good if you have a not-so-functional mouse.
pref-screen_shake_darken-desc: When toggled, experiencing screen shake will darken your screen.
pref-screentip_color-desc: The color of screen tips, the text you see when hovering over something.
pref-screentip_images-desc: When enabled, screentip hints use images for the mouse button rather than LMB/RMB.
pref-screentip_pref-desc: Enables screen tips, the text you see when hovering over something. When set to "Only with tips", will only show when there is more information than just the name, such as what right-clicking it does.
pref-see_chat_non_mob-desc: Chat messages will show above objects when they speak.
pref-sound_achievement-desc: The sound that's played when unlocking an achievement. If disabled, no sound will be played.
pref-sound_ai_vox-desc: Volume of vocal AI announcements (also known as "VOX").
pref-sound_ambience_mute_during_music-de: When enabled, ambience stops while admin music is playing.
pref-sound_ambience_volume-desc: Ambience refers to the more noticeable ambient sounds that play on occasion.
pref-sound_announcements-desc: When enabled, hear sounds for command reports, notices, etc.
pref-sound_breathing-desc: When enabled, hear breathing sounds when using internals.
pref-sound_combatmode-desc: When enabled, hear sounds when toggling combat mode.
pref-sound_ghost_poll_prompt-desc: Choose which sound prompt to play on getting ghost polls.
pref-sound_ghost_poll_prompt_volume-desc: The volume that ghost poll prompts will play at.
pref-sound_radio_noise-desc: Volume of the bloops that play when a radio message is said or received.
pref-sound_ship_ambience_volume-desc: Ship ambience refers to the low ambient buzz that plays on loop.
pref-sound_tts-desc: When enabled, be able to hear text-to-speech sounds in game. When set to "Blips", text to speech will be replaced with blip sounds based on the voice.
pref-sound_tts_hear_self_radio-desc: When enabled, hear yourself over the radio when Text to Speech and TTS Over Radio is enabled.
pref-sound_tts_hear_self_radio-name: Enable TTS Hear Self Over Radio
pref-sound_tts_radio-desc: When enabled, be able to hear text-to-speech sounds in game over radio channels. When set to "Departmental Radio Only", text to speech over the radio will only play for departmental radio channels. Anything that isn't Common. When disabled, text to speech will not play over radio sources.
pref-sound_tts_radio_volume-desc: The volume that radio text-to-speech sounds will play at. This is independent of regular TTS volume.
pref-sound_tts_volume-desc: The volume that the text-to-speech sounds will play at.
pref-stair_indicator-desc: When toggled, staircases will have a visual indicator showing which direction to walk to transition floors.
pref-status_bar-desc: When toggled, a bar at the bottom left of the screen will display the name of what your mouse cursor is hovering over.
pref-tgui_input_large-desc: Makes TGUI buttons less traditional, more functional.
pref-tgui_input_swapped-desc: Makes TGUI buttons less traditional, more functional.
pref-tgui_lock-desc: Locks TGUI windows to your main monitor.
pref-tgui_say_light_mode-desc: Sets TGUI Say to use a light mode.
pref-tgui_unlimited_windows-desc: Disables the window limit for TGUI windows. Having more than 5 windows open can tank performance on lower end computers.
pref-tip_delay-desc: How long should it take to see a tooltip when hovering over items?
pref-twelve_hour-desc: When toggled, will replace many instances of real-world time with AM/PM instead.
pref-typingindicator-desc: Enable typing indicators that show you're typing a message.
pref-ui_scale-desc: If UIs should scale up to match your monitor scaling.
pref-windowflashing-desc: When toggled, some important events will make your game icon flash on your task tray.
preferences-delete-warning: You're about to delete { $name } forever. Are you sure you want to do this?
preferences-jobless-random: Join as a random job if unavailable
preferences-jobs-drag-hint: Drag a character to a job to load that character if you are selected for that job.
preferences-slots-premium: Buy BYOND premium for more slots!
quirk-addict-desc: You are addicted to something that doesn't exist. Suffer.
quirk-ageusia-desc: You can't taste anything! Toxic food will still poison you.
quirk-alcohol_tolerance-desc: You become drunk more slowly and suffer fewer drawbacks from alcohol.
quirk-alcoholic-desc: You just can't live without alcohol. Your liver is a machine that turns ethanol into acetaldehyde.
quirk-all_nighter-desc: You didn't get any sleep last night, and people can tell! You'll constantly be in a bad mood and will have a tendency to sleep longer. Stimulants or a nap might help, though.
quirk-ananas_affinity-desc: You find yourself greatly enjoying fruits of the ananas genus. You can't seem to ever get enough of their sweet goodness!
quirk-ananas_aversion-desc: You find yourself greatly detesting fruits of the ananas genus. Serious, how the hell can anyone say these things are good? And what kind of madman would even dare put it on a pizza!?
quirk-anosmia-desc: For some reason, you can't smell anything.
quirk-asthma-desc: You suffer from asthma, an inflammatory disorder that causes your airpipe to squeeze shut! Be careful around smoke!
quirk-bad_back-desc: Thanks to your poor posture, backpacks and other bags never sit right on your back. More evenly weighted objects are fine, though.
quirk-bilingual-desc: Over the years you've picked up an extra language!
quirk-blind-desc: You are completely blind, nothing can counteract this.
quirk-blood_deficiency-desc: Your body can't produce enough blood to sustain itself.
quirk-body_purist-desc: You believe your body is a temple and its natural form is an embodiment of perfection. Accordingly, you despise the idea of ever augmenting it with unnatural parts, cybernetic, prosthetic, or anything like it.
quirk-brain_tumor-desc: You have a little friend in your brain that is slowly destroying it. Better bring some mannitol!
quirk-chip_connector-desc: You had a device installed that lets you manually add and remove skillchips! Just try not to get near any electromagnetic pulses.
quirk-chipped-desc: You got caught up in the skillchip craze a few years back, and had one of the commercially available chips implanted into yourself.
quirk-claustrophobia-desc: You are terrified of small spaces and certain jolly figures. If you are placed inside any container, locker, or machinery, a panic attack sets in and you struggle to breathe.
quirk-clown_enjoyer-desc: You enjoy clown antics and get a mood boost from wearing your clown pin.
quirk-clumsy-desc: You're clumsy, a goofball, a silly dude. You big loveable himbo/bimbo you! Hope you weren't planning on using your hands for anything that takes even a LICK of dexterity.
quirk-common_second_language-desc: Common is not your native tongue - it's something you had to pick up along the way. Some words in common will sound foreign, and you may drift back to your native tongue when you are anxious or upset.
quirk-cursed-desc: You are cursed with bad luck. You are much more likely to suffer from accidents and mishaps. When it rains, it pours.
quirk-death_mimicry-desc: You've mastered the art of faking your demise. Performing a death gasp knocks you unconscious and tricks anyone examining you into believing you've succumbed to your injuries for a short time.
quirk-deviant_tastes-desc: You dislike food that most people enjoy, and find delicious what they don't.
quirk-drunken_resilience-desc: Nothing like a good drink to make you feel on top of the world. Whenever you're drunk, you slowly recover from injuries.
quirk-eccentric_correspondent-desc: A friend or family is known to send you some exceptionally unusual mail.
quirk-empath-desc: Whether it's a sixth sense or careful study of body language, it only takes you a quick glance at someone to understand how they feel.
quirk-eradicative_chronic_illness-desc: You have an anomalous chronic illness that requires constant medication to keep under control, or else causes timestream correction.
quirk-erratic-desc: You mood swings like a pendulum, causing your personality to change on a whim every so often.
quirk-extreme_medicine_allergy-desc: Ever since you were a kid, you've been allergic to certain chemicals...
quirk-family_heirloom-desc: You are the current owner of an heirloom, passed down for generations. You have to keep it safe!
quirk-fluoride_stare-desc: You have lost your eyelids in a horrible accident, or so you tell others. You need to manually wet your eyes with a saline solution every once in a while!
quirk-food_allergy-desc: Ever since you were a kid, you've been allergic to certain foods.
quirk-foreigner-desc: You're not from around here. You don't know Galactic Common!
quirk-frail-desc: You have skin of paper and bones of glass! You suffer wounds much more easily than most.
quirk-freerunning-desc: You're great at quick moves! You can climb tables more quickly and take no damage from short falls.
quirk-friendly-desc: You give the best hugs, especially when you're in the right mood.
quirk-fundamentally_evil-desc: Where you would have a soul is but an ink-black void. While you are committed to maintaining your social standing, anyone who stares too long into your cold, uncaring eyes will know the truth. You are truly evil. There is nothing wrong with you. You chose to be evil, committed to it. Your ambitions come first above all.
quirk-gamer-desc: You are a hardcore gamer, and you have a need to game. You love winning and hate losing. You only like gamer food.
quirk-glass_jaw-desc: You have a very fragile jaw. Any sufficiently hard blow to your head might knock you out.
quirk-hemiplegic-desc: Half of your body doesn't work. Nothing will ever fix this.
quirk-heterochromatic-desc: One of your eyes is a different color than the other!
quirk-hypersensitive-desc: For better or worse, everything seems to affect your mood more than it should.
quirk-illiterate-desc: You dropped out of school and are unable to read or write. This affects reading, writing, using computers and other electronics.
quirk-immunodeficiency-desc: Whether by chronic illness or genetic happenstance, your body is a 24/7 Bed and Breakfast for bacteria, viruses, and parasites of all kinds. Even with your prescribed immunity boosters, you'll fare worse than most others.
quirk-indebted-desc: Bad life decisions, medical bills, student loans, whatever it may be, you've incurred quite the debt. A portion of all you receive will go towards extinguishing it.
quirk-jolly-desc: You sometimes just feel happy, for no reason at all.
quirk-junkie-desc: You can't get enough of hard drugs.
quirk-keen_nose-desc: You have a very sensitive nose. You can smell the contents of any open containers you are holding simply by examining them.
quirk-light_drinker-desc: You just can't handle your drinks and get drunk very quickly.
quirk-light_step-desc: You walk with a gentle step; footsteps and stepping on sharp objects is quieter and less painful. Also, your hands and clothes will not get messed in case of stepping in blood.
quirk-limper-desc: You have a pronounced limp when you walk. This will slow you down considerably. Good thing you brought your cane.
quirk-mime_fan-desc: You're a fan of mime antics and get a mood boost from wearing your mime pin.
quirk-monochromacy-desc: You suffer from full colorblindness, and perceive nearly the entire world in blacks and whites.
quirk-monophobia-desc: You have an extreme fear of loneliness, and have always tried to stick to large groups.
quirk-musician-desc: You can tune handheld musical instruments to play melodies that clear certain negative effects and soothe the soul.
quirk-mute-desc: For some reason you are completely unable to speak.
quirk-narcolepsy-desc: You feel drowsy often, and could fall asleep at any moment. Staying caffeinated, walking or even supressing symptoms with stimulants, prescribed or otherwise, can help you get through the shift...
quirk-nearsighted-desc: You are nearsighted without prescription glasses, but spawn with a pair.
quirk-numb-desc: You can't feel pain at all.
quirk-nyctophobia-desc: As far as you can remember, you've always been afraid of the dark. While in the dark without a light source, you constantly feel a sense of dread.
quirk-overconfident-desc: You've done this so many times before. What could possibly go wrong? You know you'll always come out head and shoulders over the competition!
quirk-pacifist-desc: The thought of violence makes you sick. So much so, in fact, that you can't hurt anyone.
quirk-paraplegic-desc: Your legs do not function. Nothing will ever fix this. But hey, free wheelchair!
quirk-phobia-desc: You are irrationally afraid of something.
quirk-photographer-desc: You carry your camera and personal photo album everywhere you go, and your scrapbooks are legendary among your coworkers.
quirk-photophobia-desc: Bright lights seem to bother you more than others. Maybe it's a medical condition.
quirk-poster_boy-desc: You have some great posters! Hang them up and make everyone have a great time.
quirk-prosopagnosia-desc: You have a mental disorder that prevents you from being able to recognize faces at all.
quirk-prosthetic_limb-desc: An accident caused you to lose one of your limbs. Because of this, you now have a surplus prosthetic!
quirk-prosthetic_organ-desc: An accident caused you to lose one of your organs. Because of this, you now have a surplus prosthetic!
quirk-pushover-desc: Your first instinct is always to let people push you around. Resisting out of grabs is noticeably more difficult.
quirk-pyromania-desc: Fire is fascinating to you. You feel happier when around fire, and are generally a bit more resilient to heat and flames.
quirk-pyrophobia-desc: You are terrified of fire and flames.
quirk-quadruple_amputee-desc: Oops! All Prosthetics! Due to some truly cruel cosmic punishment, all your limbs have been replaced with surplus prosthetics.
quirk-reality_dissociation_syndrome-desc: You suffer from a severe disorder that causes very vivid hallucinations and trouble expressing your ideas. Mindbreaker toxin can suppress its effects, and you are immune to mindbreaker's hallucinogenic properties. THIS IS NOT A LICENSE TO GRIEF.
quirk-scarred_eye-desc: An accident in your past has cost you one of your eyes, but you got a cool eyepatch. Yarr!
quirk-self_aware-desc: You know your body well, and can accurately assess the extent of your wounds.
quirk-settler-desc: You are from a lineage of the earliest space settlers! While your family's generational exposure to varying gravity has resulted in a ... smaller height than is typical for your species, you make up for it by being much better at outdoorsmanship and carrying heavy equipment. You also get along great with animals. However, you are a bit on the slow side due to your small legs.
quirk-shifty_eyes-desc: Your eyes tend to wander all over the place, whether you mean to or not, causing people to sometimes think you're looking directly at them when you aren't.
quirk-shock_reflex-desc: You've got some history working with live electricity, and have developed an exceptional reflex to avoid shocks.
quirk-signer-desc: You possess excellent communication skills in sign language.
quirk-skittish-desc: You're easy to startle, and hide frequently. Run into a closed locker to jump into it, as long as you have access. You can walk to avoid this.
quirk-smoker-desc: Sometimes you just really want a smoke. Probably not great for your lungs.
quirk-smooth_headed-desc: You have no hair and are quite insecure about it! Keep your wig on, or at least your head covered up.
quirk-social_anxiety-desc: Talking to people is very difficult for you, and you often stutter or even lock up.
quirk-soft_spoken-desc: You are soft-spoken, and your voice is hard to hear.
quirk-spacer-desc: You were born in space, and have never known the comfort of a planet's gravity. Your body has adapted to this. You are more comfortable in zero and artificial gravity and are more resistant to the effects of space, but travelling to a planet's surface for an extended period of time will make you feel sick.
quirk-stormtrooper_aim-desc: You've never hit anything you were aiming for in your life.
quirk-strong_stomach-desc: You can eat food discarded on the ground without getting sick, and vomiting affects you less.
quirk-tagger-desc: You're an experienced artist. People will actually be impressed by your graffiti, and you can get twice as many uses out of drawing supplies in half the time.
quirk-thanatorenasia-desc: Whenever you die and elect to "Do Not Resuscitate", your body may be taken over by another ghost upon revival - giving it an entirely new personality and fresh set of memories.
quirk-throwing_arm-desc: Your arms have a lot of heft to them! Objects that you throw just always seem to fly farther than everyone else's, and you never miss a toss.
quirk-tin_man-desc: Oops! All Prosthetics! Due to some truly cruel cosmic punishment, most of your internal organs have been replaced with surplus prosthetics.
quirk-touchy-desc: You are very touchy and have to physically be able to touch something to examine it.
quirk-transhumanist-desc: You see silicon life as the perfect lifeform and despise organic flesh. You are happier around silicons, but get frustrated when around organics. You seek to replace your failing flesh with perfect silicon. You start with a robotic augmentation.
quirk-unstable-desc: Due to past troubles, you are unable to recover your sanity if you lose it. Be very careful managing your mood!
quirk-vegetarian-desc: You find the idea of eating meat morally and physically repulsive.
quirk-voracious-desc: Nothing gets between you and your food. You eat faster and can binge on junk food! Being fat suits you just fine.
quirk-well_connected-desc: You know a guy, who knows a guy, who can get you a good deal on anything. Privately ordered items from Cargo and even black market items are cheaper for you.
quirks-reason-points: Not enough points: take a negative quirk to balance this out.
quirks-reason-positive-limit: You can't have any more positive quirks!
quirks-reason-remove-first: You need to remove a positive quirk first!
quirks-reason-slots-full: All addition slots are taken. Click a filled slot to free it.
quirks-reason-species: This quirk is incompatible with your selected species.
research-analyzer-already: This item item has already been deconstructed, and will not give any additional information.
research-analyzer-destroy-tooltip: Destroys the object currently residing in the machine.
research-analyzer-eject-tooltip: Ejects the item currently inside the machine.
research-analyzer-no-item-hint: Put any item inside to see what it's capable of!
research-analyzer-node-done: This node has already been researched.
research-analyzer-node-tooltip: Deconstruct this to research the selected node.
research-experiment-always-active: This device is configured to attempt to perform all available experiments, so no further configuration is necessary.
research-experiment-connectivity: Connectivity to this web is maintained by the following servers...
research-experiment-no-servers: Found no servers connected to a techweb!
research-experiment-none: No experiments found on this web
research-experiment-select: Select one of the following experiments...
research-experiment-select-web: Please select a techweb to connect to...
research-experiment-undiscovered-desc: This experiment has not been discovered yet, continue researching nodes in the tree to discover the contents of this experiment.
research-experimentor-no-item: No item present in experimentation chamber. Please insert one.
research-no-techweb: No research techweb found, please synchronize the console.
research-node-experiment-discount: Provides a discount of { $amount } points to all required point pools.
research-not-connected: Not connected to a server. Please sync one using a multitool.
research-not-connected-server: Not connected to a Server. Please sync one using a multitool.
rolewhitelist-hint: The lock closes a role to everyone without a grant. The eye hides it from selection menus. A category can be any game department or a custom category: the role moves there in the role selection and preferences windows.
spawnpanel-search-method-tooltip: Cycle the search method (by name, by type)
spawnpanel-search-target-tooltip: Cycle the searching target (objects, mobs, turfs)
spawnpanel-toggle-preview-tooltip: Toggle the large object preview panel
species-abductor-desc: Abductors, colloquially known as "Greys" (or "Grays"), are, three fingered, pale skinned inquisitive aliens who can't communicate well to the average crew-member.
species-android-desc: Androids are an entirely synthetic species.
species-cerulean-desc: Ceruleans are descendants of humans and vastly altered "Animalids" who originated from a populace of fanatic body modders devoted to perfecting biomechanics. Not much of these origins remain, par for their insatiable drive to endlessly chase scientific advancement.
species-dullahan-desc: An angry spirit, hanging onto the land of the living for unfinished business. Or that's what the books say. They're quite nice when you get to know them.
species-ethereal-desc: Coming from the planet of Sprout, the theocratic ethereals are separated socially by caste, and espouse a dogma of aiding the weak and downtrodden.
species-felinid-desc: Felinids are one of the many types of bespoke genetic modifications to come of humanity's mastery of genetic science, and are also one of the most common. Meow?
species-fly-desc: With no official documentation or knowledge of the origin of this species, they remain a mystery to most. Any and all rumours among Nanotrasen staff regarding flypeople are often quickly silenced by high ranking staff or officials.
species-golem-desc: Golems are lithoid creatures who eat rocks and minerals to survive and adapt.
species-human-desc: Humans are the dominant species in the known galaxy. Their kind extend from old Earth to the edges of known space.
species-jelly-desc: Jellypeople are a strange and alien species with three eyes, made entirely out of gel.
species-lizard-desc: The militaristic Lizardpeople hail originally from Tizira, but have grown throughout their centuries in the stars to possess a large spacefaring empire: though now they must contend with their younger, more technologically advanced Human neighbours.
species-monkey-desc: Monkeys are a type of primate that exist between humans and animals on the evolutionary chain. Every year, on Monkey Day, Nanotrasen shows their respect for the little guys by allowing them to roam the station freely.
species-moth-desc: Hailing from a planet that was lost long ago, the moths travel the galaxy as a nomadic people aboard a colossal fleet of ships, seeking a new homeland.
species-plasmaman-desc: Found on the Icemoon of Freyja, plasmamen consist of colonial fungal organisms which together form a sentient being. In human space, they're usually attached to skeletons to afford a human touch.
species-pod-desc: Podpeople are largely peaceful plant based lifeforms, resembling a humanoid figure made of leaves, flowers, and vines.
species-shadow-desc: Victims of a long extinct space alien. Their flesh is a sickly seethrough filament, their tangled insides in clear view. Their form is a mockery of life, leaving them mostly unable to work with others under normal circumstances.
species-skeleton-desc: A rattling skeleton! They descend upon Space Station 13 Every year to spook the crew! "I've got a BONE to pick with you!"
species-snail-desc: Snailpeople are viscous, slimy beings with a shell on their back.
species-spirit-desc: Spirits are spirits of long-dead creatures whom, for one reason or another, still roam around.
species-vampire-desc: A classy Vampire! They descend upon Space Station Thirteen Every year to spook the crew! "Bleeg!!"
species-zombie-desc: A rotting zombie! They descend upon Space Station Thirteen Every year to spook the crew! "Sincerely, the Zombies!"
stat-charisma-desc: Force of personality: winning people over and leading them.
stat-endurance-desc: Toughness and stamina: how much punishment you can take.
stat-intelligence-desc: Mental acuity: learning, reasoning and technical know-how.
stat-luck-desc: Fortune and chance: sometimes things just go your way.
stat-perception-desc: Awareness and attention to detail: noticing what others miss.
stat-strength-desc: Raw physical power: lifting, striking and carrying.
summonert-busy: A summon is in progress, waiting for ghosts to answer.
summonert-ghosts-hint: Ghosts who accept the poll after the summon become the team. The list shows who is online now.
summonert-no-spawn: There are no response team spawn points on the map.
summonert-opt-admin-ghost: Only works while you are a ghost
summonert-opt-shuttle-none: This team has no custom shuttle
summonert-preview-empty: Pick a team type to see its loadout
techweb-node-ai-desc: Exploration of AI systems, more intelligent than the entire crew put together.
techweb-node-ai_laws-desc: Delving into sophisticated AI directives, with hopes that they won't lead to humanity's extinction.
techweb-node-anomaly_research-desc: Delving into the study of mysterious anomalies to investigate methods to refine and harness their unpredictable energies.
techweb-node-anomaly_shells-desc: New shells designed to utilize anomaly cores, maximizing their potential in innovative ways.
techweb-node-applied_bluespace-desc: With a heightened grasp of bluespace dynamics, sophisticated applications and technologies can be devised using data from bluespace crystal analyses.
techweb-node-atmos-desc: Maintaining station air and related life support systems.
techweb-node-augmentation-desc: For those who prefer shiny metal over squishy flesh.
techweb-node-basic_arms-desc: Ballistics can be unpredictable in space.
techweb-node-bci-desc: Embedded brain circuits. May occasionally stream Nanotrasen ads in dreams.
techweb-node-beam_weapons-desc: So advanced, even engineers are baffled by its operational principles.
techweb-node-bepis_aus_security-desc: It is said that security in the Australicus sector is tight, so we took some pointers from their equipment. Thankfully, our sector lacks any signs of these, 'dropbears'.
techweb-node-bepis_extreme_office-desc: Some of our smartest lab guys got together on a Friday and improved our office efficiency by 350%. Here's how.
techweb-node-bepis_light_apps-desc: Applications of lighting and vision technology not originally thought to be commercially viable.
techweb-node-bepis_mod_experimental-desc: Applications of experimentality when creating MODsuits have created these...
techweb-node-bepis_posisphere-desc: Recent developments on cost-cutting measures have allowed us to cut positronic brain cubes into twice-as-cheap spheres. Unfortunately, it also allows them to move around the lab via rolling maneuvers.
techweb-node-bepis_spec_eng-desc: Conventional wisdom has deemed these engineering products 'technically' safe, but far too dangerous to traditionally condone.
techweb-node-bepis_sticky_advanced-desc: Taking a good joke too far? Nonsense!
techweb-node-bio_scan-desc: Advanced technology for analyzing patient health and reagent compositions, ensuring precise diagnostics and treatment in the medical bay.
techweb-node-bitrunning-desc: Bluespace technology has led to the development of quantum-scale computing, which unlocks the means to materialize atomic structures while executing advanced programs.
techweb-node-bluespace_theory-desc: Basic studies into the mysterious alternate dimension known as bluespace.
techweb-node-bluespace_travel-desc: Facilitate teleportation methods based on bluespace principles to revolutionize logistical efficiency.
techweb-node-borg_medical-desc: Let them follow Asimov's First Law.
techweb-node-borg_mining-desc: To mine places too dangerous for humans.
techweb-node-borg_service-desc: Let them do the cookin' by the book.
techweb-node-borg_utility-desc: Let them wipe our floors for us.
techweb-node-botany_equip-desc: Essential tools for maintaining onboard gardens, supporting plant growth in the unique environment of the space station.
techweb-node-cafeteria_equip-desc: When standard-issue tubed food no longer satisfies the station crew's appetite...
techweb-node-chem_synthesis-desc: Synthesizing complex chemicals from electricity and thin air... Don't ask how...
techweb-node-consoles-desc: User-friendly consoles for non-technical crew members, enhancing communication and access to essential station information.
techweb-node-construction-desc: Tools and essential machinery used for station maintenance and expansion.
techweb-node-cryostasis-desc: The result of clown accidentally drinking a chemical, now repurposed for safely preserving crew members in suspended animation.
techweb-node-cyber_combat_implants-desc: To make sure that you can wake the f*** up, samurai.
techweb-node-cyber_cyber_implants-desc: Advanced technological enhancements integrated into the body, offering improved physical capabilities.
techweb-node-cyber_cyber_organs-desc: We have the technology to rebuild him.
techweb-node-cyber_cyber_organs_adv-desc: Cutting-edge cybernetic organs offering enhanced sensory capabilities, making it easier than ever to detect ERP.
techweb-node-cyber_cyber_organs_upgraded: We have the technology to upgrade him.
techweb-node-cyber_integrated_toolsets-d: Decades of contraband smuggling by assistants have led to the development of a full toolbox that fits seamlessly into your arm.
techweb-node-cybernetics-desc: Sapient robots with preloaded tool modules and programmable laws.
techweb-node-cytology-desc: Cellular biology research focused on cultivation of limbs and diverse organisms from cells.
techweb-node-electric_weapons-desc: Energy-based weaponry designed for both lethal and non-lethal applications.
techweb-node-energy_manipulation-desc: Harnessing the raw power of lightning arcs through sophisticated energy control methods.
techweb-node-exodrone-desc: Adapted arcade machines to covertly harness gamers' skills in controlling real drones for practical purposes.
techweb-node-exotic_ammo-desc: Specialized bullets designed to ignite, freeze, and inflict various other effects on targets, expanding combat capabilities.
techweb-node-exp_tools-desc: Enhances the functionality and versatility of station tools.
techweb-node-fishing_anomalous-desc: For the truly adventurous fisher, these experimental tools could augment your catches in unpredictable ways.
techweb-node-fishing_equip-desc: Basic fishing gear tailored for space station environments, perfect for extraterrestrial aquatic pursuits.
techweb-node-fishing_equip_adv-desc: Continuing advancements in fishing technology, incorporating cutting-edge features in space fishing operations. Just don't try this on space carps...
techweb-node-food_proc-desc: Top-tier kitchen appliances from Nanotrasen, designed to keep the crew well-fed and happy.
techweb-node-fundamental_sci-desc: Establishing the bedrock of scientific understanding, paving the way for deeper exploration and theoretical inquiry.
techweb-node-fusion-desc: Investigating fusion reactor technology to achieve sustainable and efficient energy production through controlled plasma reactions involving noble gases.
techweb-node-gaming-desc: For the slackers on the station.
techweb-node-gas_compression-desc: Highly pressurized gases hold potential for unlocking immense energy capabilities.
techweb-node-gene_engineering-desc: Research into sophisticated DNA manipulation techniques, enabling the modification of human genetic traits to unlock specific abilities and enhancements.
